title: Protons Race Around One Tunnel 11,245 Times a Second

scenes.text: Protons race around one tunnel 11,245 times every single second.
It's the Large Hadron Collider at CERN, the biggest machine ever built.
At full energy, the protons run just three meters per second slower than light.
Then it smashes them together about two billion times a second.
To do it, its magnets are cooled colder than outer space.
The fastest lap track on Earth. Watch that count again.

description:
Protons circle the Large Hadron Collider 11,245 times every second.
At full energy they travel just three meters per second slower than light, and collide about two billion times a second.
Its magnets are colder than outer space.
What would you smash together first?
first_comment: If you could ask the LHC one question, what would it be?
